# Nihad Kerić

> Nihad Kerić is a Senior Frontend Software Engineer based in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 8 years of experience in Angular, NgRx, TypeScript, React and Next.js. Slovenian citizen with work permits for the EU and Switzerland. Languages: Bosnian, Slovenian, English, German.

## Experience
